people.name: Hester Moss
people.role: Keeper of the Gull & Lantern inn.

lines.text: She remembers something important about herself.
She taught you an old lullaby she has hummed all her life.
Warm, busy, and kind to strangers.
You returned his lost logbook.
Gruff, weathered, and quietly watchful of the fog.
You're together. She writes about you every night.
One of your closest friends.
You found her missing pages.
She writes everything down so nothing is lost.
You're together. She pretends not to blush.
One of your closest friends.
You brought back her mother's bow.
Blunt, sharp-eyed, and more caring than she lets on.
You're together. She tells the gulls about you.
One of your closest friends.
You helped finish the Gull's Wing.
Loud, bold, and desperate to see what lies past the fog.
He forged you the Kestrel Blade.
Cheerful, soot-covered, and missing his cat.

people.name: Wendel Pike
people.role: Retired fisherman on the western shore.

lines.text: You relit his late wife's waystone lamps.
Forgetful, wry, and wiser than he looks. Ask him if you're stuck.
